Textes et monuments figurés relatifs aux mystères de Mithra, Tome I
Franz Cumont, 1899
========================================================================

PROVENANCE NOTE (Tower of Babel staging): In French. Tome I (texts and critical introduction) of Cumont's monumental corpus of Mithraic sources — the foundational reference work of Mithraic studies, gathering every known inscription and literary text. The library holds Cumont's 1903 English summary (The Mysteries of Mithra); this is the full scholarly corpus behind it. Source: Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/in.gov.ignca.10835). This 1899 French original (Bruxelles: Lamertin, 1899) is in the public domain in the United States.

========================================================================
